text_block_list.name: Mayano & Biko
text_block_list.text:
Ready, set... Happy birthday—☆ Ready, 
set... Happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Calling me out to a place like this, I 
wondered what it was for! Heheh... this 
really fires me up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I even got you a birthday present! And 
that is... tadaa! A racing suit!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
An acquaintance of my dad made it for me 
because they had leftover materials♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's totally, completely perfect for 
Hishiama-san! It feels so mature and 
strong!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wild, just like a hero! That's what we 
think makes Hishi Ama-neechan so "cool"!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... d-did you not like it...? Um, it's 
totally okay! If so, we can do something 
elseâ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'd hate it! It just... touched 
my heart a little, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You picked it thinking it suited me best, 
right? Then whether it's a mature woman or 
a hero, it'll definitely be perfect for 
me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If that's how you guys really feel— then 
I'll wear it with pride, no holding back!!
